name: s21-resp-repl-image
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

home_files.post.py:
import json, sys
event = json.load(sys.stdin)
with open(r'{BASE}/hooklog.txt', 'a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    fh.write(event.get('hook_event_name', '?') + ' ' + str(event.get('tool_name')) + chr(10))

runs.stdin:
/title
/image red.png
